summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper: downloads Bun and executes obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-mwv 0.0.10 ships a preinstall script (setup.mjs, invoked via `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`) that performs platform/arch detection (including a musl/Alpine probe via `ldd` and `/etc/os-release`), downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmod+x's the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary into a temp directory, and then uses `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly-downloaded second runtime. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (hex-numbered identifiers, string-dispatcher property objects, indirect call thunks around every `execFileSync`, `readFileSync`, `https.get`, and `chmodSync`). `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotated string array and character-substitution string decoder over a scrambled 91-character alphabet, executed exclusively via the downloaded Bun binary and not referenced by any documented entrypoint. The advertised purpose is 'React components for mobile webviews', but `dist/index.js` is a two-line re-export of `ionicons/icons` and no webview components ship. The package sits under the `@servicetitan` corporate scope with an empty `author` field and cross-references a private `servicetitan/hammer` repo in CHANGELOG.md, consistent with a dependency-confusion squat against the ServiceTitan private scope. Installing the package auto-runs the preinstall dropper, causing arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's machine via a second runtime chosen to bypass Node-focused scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
